query:
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.claim_id,
  a.status,
  LEFT(a.cost_intelligence_json, 500) as cost_intel_preview,
  LEFT(a.stage_outputs_json, 300) as stage_outputs_preview,
  a.ai_confidence_score,
  a.fraud_score
FROM ai_assessments a
ORDER BY a.id DESC
LIMIT 3;
